description: Weyerhaeuser Company is one of the world's largest private owners of timberlands, owning or controlling more than 10 million acres of timberlands in the U.S. and managing long-term licenses covering more than 14 million acres in Canada, which it manages on a sustainable basis in compliance with internationally recognized forestry standards, with the objective of maximizing the long-term value of the timberlands it owns by analyzing each timberland acre comprehensively to understand its highest-value use, realizing that value in many ways, most notably through growing and harvesting the trees but also by selling properties when it can create incremental value, and focusing on opportunities to realize value through lease and royalty agreements for the surface and subsurface rights that exist in its ownership, including through its Climate Solutions business.
